extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by f(x) as x approaches a.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit at infinity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit as x increases or decreases without bound.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g≤f≤h and lim g=lim h=L, then lim f=L.

extracted_concepts.name: Average rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Slope of secant line over interval.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate at a single instant; limit of average rates.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line through point with slope equal to derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation rules
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power, constant, sum, product, quotient rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiate equations not solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-order derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives of derivatives, f'', f''', etc.

extracted_concepts.name: Related rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relate rates of quantities changing with time.

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous function on closed interval attains max and min.

extracted_concepts.name: First derivative test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use sign of f' around critical point.

extracted_concepts.name: Second derivative test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use f'' at critical point for local extrema.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f''>0 concave up, f''<0 concave down.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find maximum or minimum under constraints.
